title: Face localization inside the group completion
statement: Let $Q$ be a commutative monoid, written additively, and let $Q^{\mathrm{gp}}$ and $i:Q\to Q^{\mathrm{gp}}$ be its canonical group completion [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. For a submonoid $F\subseteq Q$, define the face-localization submonoid by $Q_F=\{i(q)-i(f):q\in Q,\ f\in F\}\subseteq Q^{\mathrm{gp}}$, with the addition and zero inherited from $Q^{\mathrm{gp}}$. When $Q$ is integral this is the localization of $Q$ at $F$; the construction itself is defined for every commutative monoid and every submonoid, without requiring that $F$ be a face.

source.place: Expose VIII 3.1.1--3.1.2, printed p. 98; localization inside the group completion.
